about_text: Speak English Today helps students speak English spontaneously and fluently.

choose_text: Please provide basic information and complete the assessment.
intro_en: Read each of the following statements, and rate yourself on a 1–5 scale, where each rating corresponds to how well a statement describes you. Use each number only once for each question.

thanks_en: Thank you! Your answers have been received.
